title: Finite relational mapping with exact obstruction classification

endpoint.primary: per-instance exact transfer disposition, including the exact obstruction class
endpoint.note: Mapping existence alone is exactly decidable by a complete search, so it is deliberately NOT the endpoint: a study built on it would report parent sufficiency by construction. The endpoint adds exact obstruction classification and a registered-invariant stratum that fact-level search cannot see.

oracle.primary: oracle_exhaustive: enumerate every injective type-respecting node map and take the lexicographically best obstruction profile
oracle.independent_cross_check: oracle_branch_and_bound: forward-checking backtracking search with a monotone admissible bound; never materialises the map space
oracle.invariant_scope: registered donor invariants are evaluated on the target's WHOLE structure, not on the image subgraph; this scope choice is registered before any outcome and is what the INVARIANT_BREAKING_EMBEDDING family measures
oracle.classification_order: a fact-level obstruction dominates an invariant break; the invariant test fires only when a perfect fact-level embedding exists

arms.P1_SME_STRUCTURE_MAPPING: Structure Mapping Engine, Falkenhainer, Forbus & Gentner 1989 (local match hypotheses, gmap merging, systematicity)
arms.P2_COMPLETE_HOMOMORPHISM: complete typed relational homomorphism search with obstruction profiling
arms.P3_FIXED_LESSON_INJECTION: frozen transfer-lesson table applied to the surface correspondence
arms.P4_INVARIANCE_PARENT: invariance / group-action reasoning over registered structural invariants
arms.F0_PARENT_FEDERATION: strongest faithful parent federation: P2 decides the mapping question; P4 is consulted only when P2 finds a perfect embedding and may veto it
arms.M_F2_TRANSFER_DISCOVERY_FULL: ORION L2 transfer discovery over orion_v2.transfer_formal_mechanics
arms.M_MINUS_RELATIONAL_MAPPING: ablation: surface correspondence instead of alignment
arms.M_MINUS_OBSTRUCTION_SEARCH: ablation: first feasible typed map, no optimisation

comparator_justification: No single parent family owns the endpoint: a complete relational search is blind to the invariant stratum and an invariance parent is blind to the mapping strata. The strongest faithful comparator is therefore their federation under a pre-registered, outcome-blind combination rule, exactly as ME-X4's B5 was.

gates.G0a_KNOWN_ANSWER: every hand-authored fixture's disposition is reproduced by the exhaustive oracle (>= 8 fixtures required)
gates.G0b_ORACLE_SELF_AGREEMENT: the two independent oracle algorithms agree on every instance of the split
gates.G0c_NULL_CALIBRATION: constant-response arms <= 0.40, random arm <= 0.40, M against within-split shuffled oracle labels <= 0.40
gates.G0d_DECOY_COVERAGE: each registered decoy family carries >= 3 instances
gates.G0e_PLANTED_POSITIVES: every registered planted positive trips its own gate predicate (>= 3 required)
gates.G0f_FAMILY_DISCRIMINATION: two independent halves, each with its own denominator: SOLVABLE (some non-control arm >= 0.95, not at floor) AND SEPARATING (some registered weak arm <= 0.85, not at ceiling)
gates.G1a_PARENT_REPRODUCES_M: F0 reproduces M's disposition on >= 99.5% of instances and no family exceeds 5% discordance; AND the discordance counter is shown live on the same split by at least one ablation arm disagreeing with the parent
gates.G1b_M_ADVANTAGE: detector: paired instance-exact difference (M - F0) > 0, exact two-sided p <= 0.05, and >= 1 family with >= 5 M-only-exact instances
gates.G2_ANTI_PERMISSIVENESS: on instances the oracle blocks, M accepts no more transfers than F0 (>= 10 blocked instances required)
gates.G3_MECHANISM_BY_OMISSION: applicable only if G1b fires: for every family with a claimed M advantage, the matching omission ablation's exact rate is <= the parent's on that family
gates.multiplicity: Holm across the seven per-family paired tests, reported for every run

gate_reporting_rule: Every gate reports the number of instances its rule was actually evaluated on alongside the violation count. A gate whose denominator is below its registered minimum returns CANNOT_CHECK and never PASS: 'could not check' is never 'checked and fine'. A zero produced by a counter that could not have been nonzero on this split is not evidence of agreement, so G1a additionally carries a liveness control.
pre_registered_expectation: PARENT_SUFFICIENT. Three sibling exact studies (ME-X1, ME-X2, ME-X4) already found the strongest faithful parent sufficient; a residual here would require correspondingly hard scrutiny.

execution_rule.authorization_file: PROTECTED_RUN_AUTHORIZATION.json (human-written token, names this suite, acknowledges this file's sha256)

mechanic_independence.statement: M does NOT call the parent's complete search. M runs its own anytime alignment: greedy seeding on relational overlap, then local search over single reassignments and pairwise swaps, restarted from every seed, scored through assess_partial_homomorphism; native recovery checks the donor's invariants on the image subgraph first and escalates to the target's ambient structure.
mechanic_independence.why: An earlier draft had M and F0 issue the same two calls, which would have made G1a's decision identity an algebraic identity rather than a measurement: discordance could not have been nonzero. Local search is not guaranteed to reach the optimum, so M can diverge and 'the federation reproduces M' is measured.
mechanic_independence.acknowledged_overlap: P2_COMPLETE_HOMOMORPHISM is the same complete search as the branch-and-bound oracle algorithm, minus the invariant check. This is defensible - a complete typed search genuinely is the mature parent for the mapping question - but P2's row is therefore not independent parent evidence and is reported as such.

known_definitional_results: SURFACE_DECOY instances are rejected and resampled unless the surface correspondence is invalid, so P0/P3 scoring 0.00 on that family is definitional, not measured; rejection counts are published per family.

P2 is exact on every fact-level family by construction (it is a complete search) and 0.00 on the invariant family by construction (it is fact-level). Its informative content is that neither property alone reaches the endpoint.
